overview: No anticheat parses the play-state disconnect packet. The only real packet references are plumbing: Artemis registers PacketPlayServerKickDisconnect (PacketRepository SERVER_PLAY+39, the GPacketPlayServerKickDisconnect wrapper, ProtocolGeneratorDirect and HardcodeMap) and Negativity declares the KICK_DISCONNECT PacketType constant. The rest of the corpus is the anticheats' own kick enforcement matched on the Kick keyword: NCP KickCommand and DenyLoginCommand, intave FaultKicks, Arc PunishmentManager and PlayerPendingKickEvent, Negativity KickCommand and PlayerCheatKickEvent, Peyang Kick, KickUtil and BanAnalyzer, CheaterDeleter TeleportVerifierCheck, Rammelkast and AntiCheatPlus PlayerListener, NESS MiscEvents, proton Kick, ThotPatrol, Daedalus, Kauri JoinListener, AutoEye AutoEyePlayerList, network-dev AlarmUtil and MenuUtil, and Bubble bubble.sk. All of them kick through Bukkit's player.kickPlayer; the server crafts S40 itself when it flushes the connection, so the packet is the enforcement channel, never a measured signal.
